summary.text: Pat Gallagher, listed by Ballotpedia as Patrick Gallagher, is a Democratic state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 173 since December 1, 2022 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Gallagher graduated from Cardinal Dougherty High School in 1992.
He took office in December 2022, succeeding Democrat Michael Driscoll.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Appropriations, Finance, Gaming Oversight and Professional Licensure committees.
